title: Add autonomy external alert metadata
summary: Add read-only external polling and alert metadata to the autonomy health payload.
reason: The 30-day hardening plan calls for external alert/export support. The safest next slice is a side-effect-free alert summary that schedulers or monitors can poll without adding notifier credentials, network calls, or media mutation.
behavior_before: External monitors could parse overall autonomy health, blockers, and review items, but there was no compact alert summary with a stable schema, dedupe key, poll interval, and no-side-effect guarantees.
behavior_after: Autonomy health includes a read-only external alert payload that summarizes ready/review/blocked state for polling systems without sending notifications, writing files, or changing pipeline state.
